title: Brčko hospitality proprietors’ warning action against COVID-related business restrictions
reason: The BN report identifies 20 proprietors and describes a two-hour closure of separate premises; it does not document a simultaneous public gathering of 50 or more.
notes: This was a separate Brčko District action seeking a meeting and assistance from the District Government. It is not combined with the Republic of Srpska protests. If new evidence establishes a qualifying public gathering, revisit separately.

title: GRAS workers’ warning strike over blocked company account
reason: RFE describes a 04:00–06:00 workplace warning strike, not a reported public gathering. Attendance is unreported, the issue is a company-specific blocked account and unpaid wages, and the union representative said he did not know whom they were protesting against; the codebook requires a 50+ gathering making a demand of government and excludes company labor negotiations absent public action or a state-policy demand.
notes: Kept separate from the 16 October protest at company premises. Not evidence of no other demonstration.
